correctness.rationale: The exact specialization at P=[1:2:4:8] verifies the published B4 quartic equation, all sixteen incidences, and a one-dimensional interpolation space. After the displayed linear change the equation is independent of the vertex coordinate, and exact Groebner calculations on all three affine patches show the plane quartic base is smooth. Smoothness of the base implies the cone is smooth away from the vertex, hence normal. The vertex is an ordinary quadruple point with genus-three projectivized tangent cone. Blowing up the vertex gives exceptional curve self-intersection -4, and adjunction gives discrepancy -2.
